market.what: Oilfield corrosion inhibitors for CO2/H2S production lines, world
market.method: Bottom-up: (97 mb/d oil + 250 mb/d water) ~55 Mt/d fluids x 25 ppm product (est.) = 0.5 Mt/yr x ~$4/kg (est.) = $2.0B; matches $1.89B report (others $2.6-4.6B)

value.logic: Same protection at 20% lower dose x $2.0B = $0.4B; + offshore operators avoid substitution-driven switches to weaker inhibitors (failure risk) est. $0.1B
value.revenue_logic: Sell active to service company: ~150 kt/yr actives x ~1.3% share x ~$8/kg = ~$15M
value.margin_logic: Specialty intermediate, toll made from fatty acids/amines; service firms keep formulation margin

trend.drivers: Offshore/deepwater sour fields; OSPAR substitution; UK/Norway: corrosion inhibitors are the largest substitutable discharge with fewest swaps
trend.deadline: OSPAR 2006/3 substitution goal 1 Jan 2026 (missed; yearly UK reports due 27 Feb 2026)

competition.notes: Big service firms own the field and the trial access. Locus FS raised >$40M in 2025 ($100M valuation). Many academic 'green inhibitor' papers, few pass HOCNF and sour tests

lab.synth: 1-2 step custom (amide/imidazoline or amino-acid surfactant from catalog acids/amines), 3 variants
lab.test: Bubble-cell LPR (ASTM G59) and rotating cylinder (ASTM G185) under CO2 and CO2/H2S at a corrosion lab (e.g. Ohio U ICMT, Intertek); HOCNF ecotox screen: OECD 306, ISO 10253 Skeletonema, ISO 14669 Acartia, OECD 117
lab.logic: Synth 5-6 wk, $15k; corrosion tests 4-6 wk, ~$18k (est.); ecotox screen 4 wk in parallel, ~$17k (est.)

sale.gates: Full GLP HOCNF + OCNS/Norway registration 3-6 mo; operator lab qual then field trial with coupons/ER probes 6-12 mo; TSCA/REACH for new active
